3. identityConsistency - 1: Players are reduced to featureless red/grey blobs with no discernible facial or uniform details.
4. motionFidelity - 1: The subtle shifts in player positions do not reflect the actual movement of players or the ball seen in the source.
5. sceneFidelity - 1: The stadium background has been replaced by a row of houses, failing to preserve the spatial context.
6. stylizationStrength - 5: The transformation into a high-contrast, cel-shaded cartoon style is very obvious and aggressively applied.
